agent_evaluations.rationale: OSCE lacks critical medication management content. While the scenario topic (VTE Prophylaxis) is clinically appropriate, the expected answers section contains only generic management statements without specific anticoagulation medications, doses, frequencies, PBS codes, renal dosing adjustments, or drug interaction warnings. This represents a fundamental failure to provide actionable Australian medication management guidance. Australian doctors must know exact enoxaparin/apixaban/dalteparin dosing regimens, PBS restrictions, and contraindications for AMC Clinical Examination. Content requires complete rewrite with specific Australian anticoagulation protocols (NHMRC guidelines, eTG Anticoagulation chapter).
